symmetric_kl_definition: 0.5*(KL(q_true||q_swapped)+KL(q_swapped||q_true)); dependence diagnostic, no action meaning asserted
assumptions: Each of the eight fixed currents has an artificial equiprobable choice of its actual or cyclic-replacement future; observe one draw from the corresponding saved diagonal Gaussian, and current/pair identity. No other future-dependent inputs. Bound applies pairwise then averaged.
limits: Not an accuracy measurement, not a mutual-information estimate, not a natural-data or action prediction guarantee. Does not apply to observing posterior mu deterministically or multiple z draws. Future replacement can be OOD.
